name: README
text: Language-neutral behaviour spec for the agent_trigger_matrix router. One case per line. The bash implementation (canonical/tools/lane_recycler/lane_recycler.sh) is the FIRST implementation that passes it; the Python port must pass this same file unchanged. Runner: cases_runner.sh in this directory. Schema: {name, hook_stdin, matrix_fixture, projects_fixture?, expected:{decision, model, subagent_type, prompt_header_contains[], event_row}}. matrix_fixture is "live" (the real agent_trigger_matrix.toml) or {base:"live", replace:[[regex,replacement],...]} applied line-wise, or {literal:"..."}. projects_fixture materialises one CLI subagent transcript: {agent_id, calls, lane_dir}. decision is allow|deny. model/subagent_type are the values of hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput after the hook runs; null means the field must be absent from updatedInput OR updatedInput must be absent (a deny). prompt_header_contains are substrings that must ALL appear in updatedInput.prompt; prompt_header_absent must appear in none. reason_contains applies to permissionDecisionReason. event_row is a tab-separated event the hook must have appended for this session (matched as a substring of any row).

name: rule2-THE-RULING-body-words-never-route

tool_input.description: squeue check on the training node
tool_input.prompt: Every claim is a LEAD TO VERIFY. No background waits, no sleep, no polling, no Monitor tool. Do not watch or wait for anything.

why: MEASURED: matching topics against the prompt BODY sends 426 of 510 historical spawns (83.5%) to watch-poll-wait, which REFUSES. Against the description only: 3 of 510 (0.6%). This case is the ruling.

name: rule2-whole-words-only
why: the topic 'watch' must not match inside 'rewatching' or 'stopwatchers'; first unrouted spawn of the session is the one menu deny

name: rule4-the-retry-fails-open-to-defaults
why: same session_id as the previous case, and it must run SECOND

name: shape-header-present-when-codex-is-on-this-host
why: [codex].binary is pointed at `sh`, which exists on every host, so the case does not depend on codex being installed

name: codex-engine-row-falls-back-to-its-claude-model-with-no-wrapper
why: ruling R2: a codex row that cannot dispatch falls back to the row's Claude model, loudly

name: parse-failure-fails-OPEN-and-says-so

why: a router that blocks a spawn is worse than one that misses; the spawn must go through UNCHANGED (no updatedInput at all)

name: budget-is-a-READ-warn-5-in-the-matrix-denies-the-same-10-calls
why: changing a number in the toml MUST change behaviour; this case fails the moment the budget is copied back into lane_recycler.conf

name: a-spawn-from-inside-a-lane-is-still-routed
why: the router runs BEFORE the agent_id discriminator. Subagents cannot spawn agents today, so this is defensive: if that ever changes, the spawn is routed rather than counted as a tool call.

name: session-start-emits-the-menu-as-additionalContext
why: PROVEN in CLI 2.1.278: a SessionStart hook's additionalContext reaches the model verbatim (probe run2.json)

name: NOTE-prefer-cases
text: The cases below specify the `prefer` candidate ladder (operator ruling 2026-09-20, 'we shouldn't be blocked if codex is maxed out' / 'prefer codex, if not available, use opus'). They are marked implemented_in_bash:false — the bash router still reads the derived model/engine/codex_* columns. They are the contract the Python port must satisfy. Availability is a CLOSED SET, evaluated per candidate in list order: a codex candidate is unavailable when (a) the [codex].binary is not on PATH, (b) the quota cooldown marker $STATE/<session>/<[codex].cooldown_marker> exists and is younger than [codex].quota_cooldown_s, or (c) the per-host codex bound is full; a claude candidate is unavailable when the live count for that model is at its [concurrency] limit. Every skip appends one event row: skip_candidate<TAB><row>/<candidate>/<reason>. The chosen one appends: candidate<TAB><row>/<candidate>.

name: prefer-skips-claude-candidates-whose-concurrency-is-full
why: the list must always reach a usable claude candidate; that is what the A14 guard protects

name: a-quota-refusal-arms-the-cooldown-and-later-spawns-skip-codex
why: the dispatcher's refusal code is [codex].refusal_code with reason 'quota'; the router never re-tries codex until [codex].quota_cooldown_s has passed. 'absent' and 'busy' refusals do NOT arm it.

name: the-cooldown-expires
why: marker older than quota_cooldown_s (1800) is not a live cooldown

name: effort-comes-from-the-chosen-candidate-not-a-row-column
why: the Agent tool has NO effort parameter in CLI 2.1.278 (tool_input keys observed live: description, model, prompt, subagent_type). Until an installer generates one agent file per row carrying the effort, the header is the only channel that reaches the model.
